title: Incidents
description: Security incidents, linked to the real audit trail behind them.

summarize.title: Summarize with AI
summarize.advisoryNote: Advisory only, generated fresh on each request — never saved to this incident.
summarize.unavailable: No AI summary is available right now — the advisory service was unreachable. This isn't an error with this incident; try again in a moment.

createDialog.title: Report an incident
createDialog.description: Creates the incident as OPEN. Link it to related audit events now, or add them later.
createDialog.correlationIdsPlaceholder: One or more AuditEvent correlation IDs, separated by commas or whitespace
createDialog.correlationIdsHint: Optional. Pulled from the audit page's "Correlation ID" column — these drive the incident's audit trail below.

detail.lifecycleClosed: This incident is closed — the end of its lifecycle.
detail.auditTrailHint: Every recorded audit event sharing this incident's related correlation IDs — the real evidence behind it, not a static summary.
detail.auditTrailNoCorrelationIds: No correlation IDs are linked to this incident yet, so there's no audit trail to show.
detail.auditTrailEmpty: No audit events found for this incident's linked correlation IDs.
detail.notFoundBody: No incident with this ID was found in this workspace's incident list.
